spine.deviation_notes: The mana-stack resource identity (RESOURCE_CONVERSION) and MoM/Indigon economy warps land cleanly, but Ball Lightning's signature 'slow-drift + 150ms tick + inverse-velocity (slower orb = more hits = more damage)' has no matching 26-geometry; approximated as a circle tick-AoE. A player would keep the mana-as-weapon feel but lose the positional skill of drifting the orb through a pack for max hits.

skills.delivery_notes: slow orb drifts and zaps a small AoE every 150ms; Archmage adds flat lightning = % of unreserved mana on each cast. Modeled as a tick-AoE (circle) around the orb's dwell point; the projectile-drift itself is not a distinct 26-type. Shock->sunder from the lightning damage. Manabond variant is a line hit (line geometry) — same resource identity

mapping_json.motion_frame: stationary mana-caster: cast drains the pool, regen refills it, cast again — the mana bar is both cannon and shield (MoM)
mapping_json.fidelity_notes: IDENTITY = resource-as-weapon: unreserved mana drives flat lightning damage; RESOURCE_CONVERSION is the exact T4 door (resource pool converted to weapon output). MoM (mana-as-life-buffer) and Indigon (spend-more-mana -> higher-cost -> more damage feedback loop) are the economy-warping items that land in resource_economy (cost_slope escalating captures the Indigon feedback). GEOMETRY FRICTION: Ball Lightning — a slow drifting projectile that ticks a small AoE every 150ms with inverse-velocity damage — has NO clean 26-type. Mapped as 'circle' (tick-AoE around the dwell point); the drift-and-inverse-velocity is a numeric/behavioral property the geometry enum doesn't carry. Manabond variant = line. Shock->sunder (false-friend). Delivery is subordinate to the mana-stack identity per §7.2.
